description: This file is a PHP script that manages test execution navigation within the TestLink open source test management system. It includes initialization of the page, access control, and display logic for test execution dashboards, along with auxiliary functions for user permissions and interface configuration.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI configuration and permissions for the test execution dashboard based on user rights and session state.

methods.name: checkAccessToExec
methods.description: Checks user permissions to execute or view test plans, returning access grants based on user rights and test plan details.
